en.26:47: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and elders of the people.
en.26:48: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.”
en.26:49: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
en.26:50: “Friend,” Jesus replied, “do what you came for.” Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus, and arrested Him.
en.26:51: At this, one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
en.26:52: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him. “For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
en.26:53: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
en.26:54: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?”
en.26:55: At that time Jesus said to the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw? Every day I sat teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me.
en.26:56: But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled.

en.14:43: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, scribes, and elders.
en.14:44: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him and lead Him away securely.”
en.14:45: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
en.14:46: Then the men seized Jesus and arrested Him.
en.14:47: And one of the bystanders drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
en.14:48: Jesus asked the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw?
en.14:49: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me. But this has happened that the Scriptures would be fulfilled.”
en.14:50: Then everyone deserted Him and fled.
en.14:51: One young man who had been following Jesus was wearing a linen cloth around his body. They caught hold of him,
en.14:52: but he pulled free of the linen cloth and ran away naked.

en.22:47: While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called Judas, one of the Twelve. He approached Jesus to kiss Him.
en.22:48: But Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
en.22:49: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
en.22:50: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
en.22:51: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.
en.22:52: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for Him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?
en.22:53: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.”

en.18:2: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
en.18:3: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
en.18:4: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
en.18:5: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
en.18:6: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
en.18:7: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
en.18:8: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
en.18:9: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
en.18:10: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
en.18:11: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”
en.18:12: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.
